Orbbecs by serial + colour interface; the ARC wrist cameras have no serial, so by USB port (re-check with recording/run_cameras.sh --list / --snapshot after re-cabling). ARC 640x480 MJPG exists only at 120 fps: decoded at <= 60 fps. Mapping confirmed by the user 2026-10-21: ARC @ 1-3.1 = right wrist, ARC @ 1-3.3 = left wrist, Gemini 305 = knife camera on the left arm.
